0.6.0.description:
# DOOM Eternal Archipelago v0.6.0 — Sentinel Core & Unified Campaign

v0.6.0 brings the Base Campaign and both parts of The Ancient Gods into one Archipelago campaign, with the Fortress of Doom as its hub, a dedicated AP save, randomized mission progression, and native menus that show your Archipelago progress.

The game integration now uses **Sentinel Core 1.0.0** instead of a separate Meathook installation.

## Updating from v0.5.3

- **Generate a new seed with the v0.6.0 APWorld.** v0.5.x rooms and campaign saves are not migrated into the new campaign system.
- Use the **v0.6.0 launcher and matching `doometernal.apworld`** together.
- Extract the release into a **new, empty folder** rather than overwriting an older installation.
- Connect to your room and use the launcher to prepare the room package, install the game integration, and start the AP campaign.
- Your vanilla campaign saves are separate from the new AP campaign.

## One campaign, three ways to progress

- Added a **unified campaign** covering Base Campaign, TAG1, and TAG2 missions without switching between separate campaign inventories and save slots.
- Made the **Fortress of Doom the universal hub**, including for campaigns that mix Base and DLC missions or use DLC missions only.
- Added a unified **Mission Select** in the game menu and at the **Fortress mission-selection orb**.
- Added **Random Mission Order**: the seed determines the mission sequence, and completing a mission reveals the next one.
- Added **Mission Access as Items**: individual mission-access items unlock the corresponding missions through Archipelago.
- Mission access opens travel; the checks inside the mission still follow their traversal and combat requirements.
- Added **Vanilla Order** within the unified campaign for chronological progression.
- Set **Random Mission Order** as the default mission-order option.
- Completed missions stay available for replay. Replaying a mission does not remove its completion or advance progression a second time.
- Mission exits return through the Fortress instead of relying on the next mission in the original campaign script.
- Unrevealed missions appear as **`???`**, with their previews and details hidden. The selected final objective has its own identifiable locked entry.
- Mission Select distinguishes **locked, available, completed, and goal missions**.

## Mission pool, campaign length, and victory options

- Replaced the simple DLC-mission inclusion switch with **Mission Pool**:
  - **Base**: the 13 Base Campaign missions.
  - **Full Saga**: the 19 campaign missions across Base, TAG1, and TAG2, plus The Dark Lord.
  - **DLC Only**: the six TAG1/TAG2 missions, plus The Dark Lord.
  - **Custom**: choose the candidate missions and whether The Dark Lord is included.
- Added **Mission Count** for Random Mission Order and Mission Access as Items: select **3–19 normal missions**, or **All**. The Dark Lord is handled separately from that count.
- Vanilla Order uses all eligible missions in chronological order rather than applying the shortened-campaign count.
- Added **Starting Missions** for Mission Access as Items, allowing **one to three initially available missions**.
- Added **Full Saga Final Boss**: choose **Icon of Sin**, **Davoth / The Dark Lord**, or let the seed choose. Chronological Full Saga ends with Davoth.
- Added **Goal Mission as Item** for Mission Access as Items. Receiving the selected boss's access item can open its mission before all other missions are completed; selected additional victory requirements still apply.
- Updated **Complete the Full Saga** to use the generated campaign and its selected final boss rather than one fixed full-length route.
- Updated **Complete All Included Missions** and the other additional victory requirements to follow the actual missions and checks included in the seed.
- Accepted the older **Complete All Enabled Missions** spelling as an alias for **Complete All Included Missions** when reading options.
- Added generation checks for the **six Base Campaign Slayer Gates required by Unmaykr objectives**, including when a shortened campaign is requested.

## Combat Readiness and seed generation

- Added **Combat Readiness**, a loadout-based progression system that evaluates weapons, usable mods, upgrades, runes, equipment, mobility, and resource sustain instead of treating every weapon as interchangeable preparation.
- Added **Campaign Difficulty** to generation: **I'm Too Young to Die, Hurt Me Plenty, Ultra-Violence, or Nightmare**. The chosen difficulty is used throughout the AP campaign, including DLC missions.
- Combat Readiness uses difficulty-specific allowances. Higher difficulty settings also assume a player who can manage a less forgiving loadout.
- Kept mechanical requirements separate from the readiness score: a high score does not substitute for equipment required to traverse a mission or perform a required action.
- Weapon mods and masteries contribute through their usable weapon families. Owning a mod without its weapon does not count as having that weapon-and-mod combination.
- Added dependency-aware selection of upgrades and equipment for shortened campaigns, including health, armor, ammo capacity, and rune preparation.
- Added extra readiness requirements at Spirit encounters when the player lacks **Plasma Rifle + Microwave Beam**, and for The Dark Lord without an effective **Sentinel Hammer**.
- Accounted for the demands of later DLC missions, including **The World Spear's traversal and sustained combat**.
- Preserved **DLC Logic Timing** as a progression choice while separating that choice from a mission's intrinsic difficulty. Allowing DLC early does not make it an easy starting mission.
- Starting-mission selection considers intrinsic mission difficulty and the starting equipment, including when DLC paths are allowed from the beginning.
- Unified readiness evaluation across the campaign planner and access rules so their decisions use the same equipment requirements.
- Updated fixed **Dash** acquisition for randomized campaigns: a route no longer has to wait for an omitted or late Exultia. The generated plan places the fixed acquisition at the appropriate opening completion or supplies it in the starting equipment when required.
- Added matching **Chainsaw** starting-equipment handling for routes that do not begin in Hell on Earth when Chainsaw randomization is disabled.
- Required effective **Super Shotgun + Meat Hook** traversal in the relevant TAG2 routes, rather than treating the Meat Hook item alone as a usable traversal tool.
- Required **Blood Punch** for the applicable Urdak and Dark Lord progression checks, including its new progressive form.
- Made item progression classifications depend on the selected campaign and its readiness needs instead of assigning the same role to every item in every seed.

## Weapon Upgrade Points and the Arsenal

- Added **Weapon Upgrade Points (3)** as an Archipelago item.
- Normal weapon-mod upgrades are now purchased with AP-delivered points in the **native Arsenal**.
- Full-length campaigns include **39 point items, worth 117 points**. Short campaigns scale their point budget with the selected weapon-mastery content.
- Full-length campaigns keep their normal-upgrade point budget even when Weapon Mastery Challenge locations are disabled.
- Removed the automatic vanilla weapon-point rewards that would bypass the AP point economy.
- Added native point accounting so inventory resynchronization does not award already-received points again or restore points already spent.
- Separated **mod ownership, purchased normal upgrades, and mastery ownership** in the Arsenal presentation.
- Mastery items apply their gameplay effect and display the corresponding mastery state without pretending that unrelated normal upgrades were purchased.
- Mastery Challenge progress stays visible independently of receiving the mastery item.

## Meat Hook, Blood Punch, and special weapons

- Added **Meat Hook as an independent Archipelago item**, separate from the Super Shotgun. Receiving the Super Shotgun alone does not grant the hook.
- Added **Progressive Blood Punch**, with four cumulative acquisitions: the ability, its area-of-effect upgrade, its charge-rate upgrade, and its increased charge capacity.
- Added support for **0–4 Progressive Blood Punch copies** in starting inventory.
- Removed boss-triggered Blood Punch upgrades that bypass the new progressive item, along with their misleading upgrade notifications.
- Made **Crucible and Sentinel Hammer usable across the unified campaign**, rather than tying their availability to the original Base/TAG2 campaign split.
- Added **Special Weapon Toggle** for switching between the Crucible and Hammer once the selected item mode grants both.
- Progressive Special Weapon keeps the Crucible available after the Hammer stages are received.
- Completed the upgraded Hammer's **Ammo Boost, Fire and Ice Boost, and Extended Daze** behavior and presentation.
- Removed the vanilla **World Spear Hammer grant** that could bypass AP ownership.
- Removed the vanilla **Mars Core Plasma Rifle pickup** that could give the weapon outside its AP placement.

## Runes, capacity upgrades, and inventory synchronization

- Integrated received runes with the native rune menu, including ownership, selection, and their visual state.
- Integrated **Support Rune** selection with the unified campaign, including **Take Back**.
- Preserved equipped rune choices when refreshing or repairing inventory instead of replacing them with cached selections.
- Added native handling of the six **Sentinel Crystal paired bonuses** from the received health, armor, and ammo upgrade tiers: **Quickdraw Belch, Loot Magnet, Napalm Belch, Health for Blood, Belch Armor Boost, and Armor for Blood**.
- Reworked persistent-item synchronization around the inventory actually present in the running game. Repairs restore missing gear without replaying the entire received-item history.
- Kept consumable deliveries separate from persistent-gear repair, avoiding extra consumables from a resync.
- Fixed **the Unmaykr being missing after inventory synchronization in The Ancient Gods**. **Closes #4.**

## Fortress progression and battery economy

- Made Fortress progression follow **unique completed missions in the generated campaign**, rather than the original campaign's visit order.
- Scaled Fortress unlock timing with campaign length so short campaigns can reach their included Fortress content.
- Scaled the active Fortress purchase groups with the size of the selected campaign. Excluded groups do not leave collectible checks or markers behind.
- Replaced **Sentinel Battery Bundles** in new seeds with **individual Sentinel Battery items**.
- Based the battery budget on the actual included paid groups. The full Fortress has **11 purchases costing two batteries each**, with a **25% surplus rounded up**: **22 required + 6 spare = 28 batteries**.
- Kept the **Praetor Suit / All Runes room** as one shared purchase rather than charging separately for its checks.
- Kept the **Fully Upgraded Suit cheat-code secret** outside the paid battery groups.
- Made story-related Fortress checks work with the unified progression instead of depending on a specific vanilla campaign visit.
- Kept paid-room access, collected checks, and battery spending across AP campaign resumes and replays.

## AP progress in the game menus and HUD

- Added **ITEMS FOUND** to the gameplay HUD and integrated AP pickup counts into the map, Mission Select, and end-of-level presentation.
- Counts use the physical AP pickups actually included in that mission. Mission Complete, Mastery Challenges, and other non-pickup checks do not inflate the collectible total.
- Gameplay pickup counts update as checks are collected, without requiring a visit to the pause menu.
- Added **fixed mission-difficulty skulls** to Mission Select. They describe the mission, not a changing comparison with the player's current Combat Readiness.
- Added AP reward information to individual **Mission Challenges** in Mission Select and the paused Challenges screen.
- Added an **All Challenges** reward card with its own completion state; its reward is revealed after the three constituent challenges have been discovered.
- Added **Weapon Mastery Challenge reward information** to the Arsenal.
- Added mastery hints when the player explicitly opens the page of a **mod they own**, including the Meat Hook page.
- Reward text identifies the item and its recipient while keeping trap rewards disguised.
- Made pickup-based challenge progress reflect the corresponding AP checks rather than unrelated received items.
- Added a native-styled **Ammo Refill HUD indicator**, showing the stored charges and configured key.
- Added **special-weapon state and toggle-key presentation** to the HUD, including the indication that switching between owned special weapons is available.
- Supported incomplete equipment loadouts in the HUD, including **Ice Bomb without Frag Grenade**.
- Updated the AP campaign's Resume entry to show the mission associated with its checkpoint.
- Removed obsolete mastery-token and vanilla weapon-point reward presentation from the affected AP screens.
- Added new **start-screen and main-menu logos**.

## Automap, replay, challenges, and campaign scenes

- Reworked Automap checked-marker updates through the native game integration so collected AP markers follow the current room and mission state.
- Integrated completed-mission **Fast Travel** with the unified Mission Select and the game's native travel flow.
- Restored **Nekravol — Die by the Sword** as an available Mission Challenge when its requirements are included.
- Improved challenge synchronization between physical AP pickups, native challenge progress, individual checks, and the all-challenges reward.
- Reworked all-challenges reward handling around the three real challenges and their AP reward, without extra dummy entries or misleading vanilla battery notifications.
- Skipped the opening cinematics of **Hell on Earth, UAC Atlantica Facility, and The World Spear** in the AP campaign.
- Skipped the ending credits after **Final Sin, The Holt, and The Dark Lord**, while retaining the mission and victory flow.

## Controls, Ammo Refill, and DeathLink

- Added a configurable **Special Weapon Toggle** key alongside the existing Ammo Refill binding in the launcher.
- Both controls can be used while moving or firing; unrelated held keys are not treated as a required shortcut combination.
- The configured keys are reflected in the HUD instead of displaying a fixed default.
- Ammo Refill replenishes the **three Crucible charges** when the Crucible is owned, including after receiving later Progressive Special Weapon stages.
- Added native **DeathLink Mode** selection:
  - **Soft** applies one lethal hit and allows **Extra Lives or Saving Throw** to protect the player.
  - **Hardcore** causes a direct death without consuming those protections as a substitute.
- Reworked DeathLink execution and death observation through Sentinel Core rather than the earlier damage-burst approach.

## Dedicated AP saves and launcher improvements

- Added a **dedicated AP campaign save** associated with the room, separate from vanilla campaign progress.
- Added AP campaign **backup, verification, and restoration tools** to the launcher.
- Added an explicit way to **back up and create a new DOOM save in the same Archipelago room**. Losing or resetting the server's `.apsave` does not force generation of another multiworld.
- Distinguished ordinary ongoing save updates from incompatible local/server progress when deciding whether to continue or offer recovery.
- Integrated AP session preparation into **Play**, including preparing a fresh launch after the previous game process exits.
- Added separate launcher status for the **room package, game installation, game integration, and inventory synchronization**.
- Separated setup and save-recovery failures so an installed room package is not automatically treated as something that must be rebuilt.
- Reworked the Session page and setup/recovery feedback around the unified campaign.
- Added the new app icon to the **launcher, Windows taskbar, and generated executable**.
- Expanded local **Support Reports** with Sentinel startup and session logs, game-integration state, save-provider selection, item-delivery information, and detailed file-operation errors.
- Improved Support Report export with a retained local copy when publication to the requested destination fails.
- Reduced repeated status messages so relevant errors and state changes are easier to find.
- Updated room-resource compilation and packaging for the selected campaign, its options, and the new runtime.

## Pool cleanup

- Removed four obsolete Automap upgrades from new item pools and the supported starting-inventory options:
  - **Reveal Automap Stations**
  - **Reveal Automap Progression Items**
  - **Larger Automap Reveal**
  - **Reveal Dossier Progression Items**
- Updated **Praetor Suit Upgrades in Pool** to the remaining **17 upgrades**, with both its default and maximum adjusted from **21 to 17**.
- Retired the obsolete generic **Rune** item entry. Named runes continue to represent the actual rune rewards.
- Scaled short-campaign mastery locations, their associated weapon families, Fortress purchases, battery supply, and point budget together rather than squeezing the entire full-campaign pool into every short seed.

## Sentinel Core and maintenance

- Replaced the separate **Meathook runtime dependency** with **Sentinel Core 1.0.0** and launcher-managed installation of its compatible runtime files.
- Removed the **SnapHak startup dependency**, eliminating its **“Failed to query total RAM” fatal error** from this integration. **Closes #3.**
- Kept developer-console access and the **`noclip`**, **`chrispy`**, and **`condump`** tools available through the new integration.
- Added version and file-integrity checks for the Core runtime package and its bootstrap, with backup and recovery during installation changes.
- Added a separate Core release workflow with ready-to-distribute runtime binaries, checksums, and compatibility metadata.
- Reorganized the bridge, launcher, native integration, and generation code; removed obsolete helpers and low-value tests, and updated the build and CI workflows.
- Adapted the Linux/Proton launcher integration to use the same Windows Sentinel Core runtime.
- Updated installation, development, and runtime documentation for the new architecture.

Thanks to **Doctor Pyro, Quartz, Dopi, TayWoodz**, the issue reporters, and everyone testing the update and sending reports.

Thanks also to **chrispy / Meathook** for the work that supported the integration, and **Kaibz Advanced Options** for demonstrating native UI possibilities. Sentinel Core includes the relevant third-party credits and licenses.

0.6.1.description:
# DOOM Eternal Archipelago v0.6.1 — Beta Corrective

- Fixed Core compatibility checks that could block DeathLink and other native commands.
- Verified DeathLink sending, receiving, death application and echo suppression in-game.
- Added separate Core management with verified downloads, offline cache and rollback.
- Added launcher actions to repair Core, recover a session and restore the previous Core.
- Improved stale prelaunch recovery and fixed repair UI actions.
- Reused verified room installations during session recovery, avoiding unnecessary reinjection.

### Updating from v0.6.0

Close DOOM and the old launcher, extract the complete new package, then reconnect to the same room and slot. Update the room package when prompted.

**Your existing seed and AP save are preserved. No new seed or save reset is required.**
0.6.1.title: 0.6.1 - Beta

0.6.2.description:
# DOOM Eternal Archipelago v0.6.2

## Generation and options

- Exultia’s first Sentinel Battery is always randomized as an AP location. Removed its randomization toggle.
- Additional Victory Requirements default to off.
- Added **Include Slayer Gates** and **Include Secret Encounters**, both enabled by default.
- Disabling Slayer Gates removes their completion checks and keys from the item pool. The Unmaykr goal requires Slayer Gates enabled.
- Progressive health, armor and ammo upgrades count as Progression, including at least one required Blood Punch acquisition.
- Random Mission Order prioritizes less demanding missions in its first four slots.
- Mission Access as Items offers more varied starting missions among equally viable choices.
- Taras Nabad and Urdak include additional sustained-combat requirements in generation logic.

## Gameplay and progression

- Weapon mastery effects follow the selected mod, keeping Sticky Bombs, Full Auto, Precision Bolt and Micro Missiles effects separate.
- Frag Grenade upgrades received before the base grenade wait for it without blocking other item deliveries.
- DeathLink now actually applies the selected mode: **Soft** uses one lethal hit with normal protections; **Hardcore** causes direct death, bypassing Extra Lives and Saving Throw.
- Taras Nabad awards Mission Complete through its final portal back to the Fortress.
- ARC Complex’s four Elena Richardson logs use ordinary AP pickups.
- Starting an AP campaign displays its available missions and initial Fortress pickups.

## HUD and Mission Select

- **ITEMS FOUND** displays throughout the supported maps and pause screens.
- The AP gameplay HUD hides both the Demonic Presence label and bar.
- Mission Select displays a separate **SLAYER GATE** row. The key turns green when received; the Gate turns green when completed.
- **All Challenges** appears in Mission Select before entering applicable missions, with an orange heading after claiming its AP reward.

## Launcher and recovery

- Inventory Resync waits up to 30 seconds for unpaused gameplay and reports waiting, timeout or cancellation.
- Closed-session recovery supports installations where DOOM and launcher data reside on different drives.
- Session preparation failures appear under **AP Session** and direct players to **AP SAVE** recovery.
- Linux/Proton adds a **Proton Executable** selector under **Join a Room**.

## Updating from v0.6.1

Close DOOM and the old launcher, extract the complete package into a new folder, update to **Sentinel Core 1.0.4**, and reconnect to the same room and slot. Update the room package when prompted.

**Existing rooms and AP saves are preserved if you don't update the APWORLD.** New option defaults and generation changes apply to newly generated seeds.
0.6.2.title: 0.6.2 - Beta

0.6.3.description:
# DOOM Eternal Archipelago v0.6.3

## Generation and options

- Fixed multiworld generation errors when DOOM Eternal is combined with other games.
- Fortress progression logic respects mission-completion unlocks and physical room access instead of treating later pickups as available from the start.
- Starting loadouts account for the two initially reachable Fortress checks: Flame Belch and Bridge Sentinel Crystal.

## Gameplay and progression

- Mars Core no longer grants an unreceived Plasma Rifle during its scripted sequence.
- World Spear no longer grants Sentinel Hammer after Valen’s cinematic before receiving its AP item.
- Fixed missing hands and a floor-level camera after reloading a checkpoint with empty weapons.
- Paired Extra Life pickups in UAC Atlantica and The Holt award both AP checks.
- Campaign goals recognize server-confirmed location checks when reconnecting and when completion updates arrive.

## HUD and Mission Select

- Added AP automap markers to Secret Encounters, with cleanup after completion.
- ARC Complex’s four Elena Richardson log pickups have AP automap markers that disappear after collection.
- Corrected ARC Complex’s Secret Encounter names to match **Generator Room** and **Building On Fire Across Gap**.
- Separated the overlapping AP pickup visuals and markers for paired Extra Lives in UAC Atlantica and The Holt.

## Launcher and recovery

- Inventory Resync recognizes all permanent weapons.
- Automatic inventory recovery verifies restored items before reporting completion.
- Ammo Refill waits up to 30 seconds for unpaused gameplay without spending a refill while waiting. Changing the room, save or level cancels the request.
- Fixed launcher errors and repeated interruption warnings during automatic room reconnection.
- Fixed room connection errors caused by a conflicting local Archipelago source installation.
- Linux/Proton launcher includes missing display libraries needed for startup and writes a startup log for troubleshooting.

**Generation and Fortress logic fixes apply to newly generated seeds using the updated APWORLD.**

## What's next

Development now (hopefully) moves on to v0.7: Random Enemies (or the Enemizer).

Check out the official DOOM Eternal thread in the Archipelago After Dark Discord for more info and support.
0.6.3.title: 0.6.3 - Beta

0.6.4.description:
# DOOM Eternal Archipelago v0.6.4

## Fixes
- Fixed console command collisions that could prevent paired Extra Life pickups in The Holt and UAC Atlantica from producing both AP checks.
- Fixed command collisions between Taras Nabad’s Mission Complete and campaign-goal events that could block Full Saga progression.
- The Fortress Unmaykr check triggers at the end of acquisition instead of during partial key insertion, preserving the correct six-key requirement, oops!

## Launcher
- Fixed the packaged Linux launcher failing to start with “attempted relative import with no known parent package.”
- Inventory Resync reads health, armor and ammo capacity stages independently and selects only confirmed missing stages.
- Unresolved inventory observations identify the affected item IDs (under the hood stuff).

**Update to Sentinel Core 1.0.6 and rebuild the room package when prompted. You may keep the same room, slot and AP save.**

## What's next
Development continues on v0.7: Random Enemies (or the Enemizer).

Check out the official DOOM Eternal thread in the Archipelago After Dark Discord for more info and support.
0.6.4.title: 0.6.4 - Beta

0.6.5.description:
# DOOM Eternal Archipelago v0.6.5

## Gameplay and item delivery

- Fixed the Unmaykr check still triggering when inserting a single or more (less than all of them) Empyrean Key. The check waits until you collect the weapon.
- Fixed DeathLink stopping both incoming and outgoing deaths after cancelling a pending death.
- Mission completion checks keep updating if DeathLink encounters an error.
- Prevented leftover mission checks from a previous room from completing missions in a new room.
- Fixed Weapon Upgrade Points blocking later item deliveries when local delivery history was missing. Recovery accounts for points already received without refunding spent points.
- Fixed a Windows item-delivery error affecting drives such as exFAT.

## Launcher and save recovery

- Improved recovery for usable AP saves incorrectly reported as corrupted.
- Added an automatic local backup before attempting to resume an existing AP save.
- Added save details and **Copy details** under **AP SAVE**, plus an option to back up available local files with the game closed.
- Support reports include more information about missing or inaccessible save files.
- Added **SELECT PROTON** shortcuts in Session and Help. Saving a valid selection retries preparation for the connected room.
- Improved session startup, communication and shutdown on Linux/Proton, including CachyOS.

## APWorld — newly generated rooms only

**The APWorld determines mission order, item placements and progression rules when you generate a room. The changes below require a new room generated with APWorld v0.6.5.**

- Fixed progression getting stuck with **Vanilla Order + Full Saga + Kill the Icon of Sin**. Final Sin stays at the end of the campaign.
- Fixed some randomized campaigns placing items needed for their opening missions too late.
- Prevented DLC Only campaigns from starting at The Dark Lord when that start could block progression.
- Fixed progression involving The Crucible with DLC content disabled, including the requirement to complete all mission challenges.
- Removed the obsolete **DLC Logic Timing** option and its From the Beginning/Late Game choices. DLC missions use their individual equipment and combat requirements.

**Existing rooms keep their original mission order, item placements and generation rules. Updating the launcher or installing the new APWorld does not apply these generation fixes to an existing room.**

## Updating from v0.6.4

Close DOOM and the old launcher, extract the complete v0.6.5 package into a new folder, update to **Sentinel Core 1.0.7**, and reconnect to the same room and slot. Rebuild the room package when prompted.

**You can keep your compatible v0.6.x room and AP save for the gameplay, launcher and recovery fixes. No save reset is required.**
0.6.5.title: 0.6.5 - Beta

0.6.6.description:
# DOOM Eternal Archipelago v0.6.6 (6)

## Linux / Proton

- Fixed a session startup failure that could show “The session supervisor requires an inherited stdin pipe” and prevent the launcher from preparing the AP campaign.
- Fixed a Proton communication issue that could interrupt session preparation with `BrokenPipeError`.
- Fixed additional Linux/Proton issues that could cause error popups or prevent AP sessions from being prepared.

## Launcher and item delivery

- Fixed item delivery getting stuck after repairing Core or a session because the game integration helper had stopped. The launcher restarts the helper when needed before reporting a successful repair.
- The launcher reports an error if the game integration helper cannot start during a repair.
0.6.6.title: 0.6.6-6 - Beta
